name: spin

fists.comment: owner pass-7: hands were open after the kick; the performer holds fists from 6 s.

plant.comment: owner pass-2: jump reads too low vs reference. Window widened to true liftoff (airborne detection fires late, eating the launch rise) + 1.35x arc boost.

smooth.comment: owner pass-2: flurry smoother. Pass-4: window 9 -> 5; a 9-frame window averaged away the punch extension peaks.

reach.comment: owner pass-4: punches don't travel far enough. Reference reaches 87-98% of arm length; restore extension on already-extending arms only.

_head_look_note: pass-6: no manual gaze correction needed any more. The estimator now emits the performer's real gaze (mesh nose vs ears) and the apply orients the head to it, clamped to gaze_max_offset_deg from the chest.

arm_follow.comment: owner pass-9: guard and punch arms follow the performer's own wrist geometry, shoulder-anchored (anatomically faithful). The residual few centimetres of hand-vs-face height are this character's proportions - forcing them out drives the hands into the torso.
